notes.title: Chubziki 0.0.7 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Dear players,

ːsteamhappyː We have patched up the bug that completely broke car-mechanic camera and equipment change, so feel free to use it!

ːsteamthumbsupː Also race-quests are patched up and should be less buggy.

ːsteamthumbsupː We have also improved overall performance, which is our second most important task, next to adding new chubziks!

ːsteamsaltyː Car driving should feel better now. Car-Upgrades are more fair.

We hope you will enjoy the smoothness of gameplay!

Yours sincerely,
Goodwin Games Team
